title: framework.config.json
description: The ONE config the framework reads from the app repo (plan D3/D5-D8). The framework never assumes where it lives; everything app-scoped is declared here.

framework.description: Pin/version metadata for the installed agentic-lifecycle distribution.

source.description: git+https URL or index used to install the pin

app_root.description: Application root, relative to this config file (or absolute). '.' means the config's own directory.

state_folder.description: GSD state root, relative to app_root (or absolute). Plan D3 uses '.framework/state'.

gate_settings.description: Gate behaviour overrides (browser output dir, environment bindings).

surface.description: How the framework surface (agents/skills/rules/commands) is injected at OpenCode config-build time.

readiness.description: App-specific paths the five readiness checks target (Phase A step 4).
